automotive-ev-battery.title: SNE Research: Chinese OEMs increasingly dominate global EV battery market
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese battery manufacturers have secured more than half of the global electric and hybrid vehicle battery market outside China during the first nine months of this year, according to SNE Research analysis. This represents a significant market shift, with Korean and Japanese suppliers losing ground in the competitive battery supply sector.

automotive-ev-battery.title: EVgo integrates first Tesla Superchargers into its network
automotive-ev-battery.summary: EVgo has opened its first location featuring Tesla Superchargers near downtown Chicago, marking the beginning of a planned integration of several hundred Superchargers into its network. This integration represents a significant collaboration between the charging network operator and Tesla to expand charging infrastructure.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Tesla to phase out Cybertruck production in Texas in favour of Cybercab
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Tesla plans to discontinue Cybertruck production at its Texas facility mid-2025 to allocate manufacturing capacity for the Robotaxi Cybercab. The decision's impact on Cybertruck's future remains uncertain, with possibilities including production relocation or complete discontinuation.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Amazon set to deploy more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Amazon is expanding its global electric vehicle deployment strategy to India, planning to introduce more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks into its operations. This expansion demonstrates the company's continued commitment to fleet electrification across multiple markets.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Vaeridion secures €124.5 million for electric Microliner
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Munich-based startup Vaeridion has secured €124.5 million in funding comprising €30 million in equity and €94.5 million in EU funding to advance its electric microliner program. The capital will support vehicle certification and production preparation at its Oberpfaffenhofen facility.

automotive-ev-battery.title: BMW offers US customers $500 in public charging credits for 2027 EVs
automotive-ev-battery.summary: BMW North America is introducing a new public charging package for 2027 model year electric vehicle customers, including $500 in charging credits and complimentary one-year IONNA membership. The offering aims to enhance charging accessibility and incentivize EV adoption among BMW customers.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Volkswagen introduces battery preconditioning for older ID. models
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Volkswagen is releasing ID. Software 3.9.1 via over-the-air update, introducing manual battery preconditioning functionality for DC fast charging on legacy ID. family vehicles. The update also improves thermal management, AC charging capabilities, and overall system stability.

automotive-ev-battery.title: ZF develops <30,000 RPM electric drive
automotive-ev-battery.summary: ZF has developed the High Revolution Drive, a compact electric motor capable of operating at up to 30,000 RPM with reduced installation space and weight requirements. The innovative design also significantly lowers magnet consumption compared to conventional electric drives.

automotive-ev-battery.title: JBM EV introduces Ecolife e12 electric bus in Singapore
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Indian electric bus manufacturer JBM Electric Vehicles has launched the Ecolife e12 electric bus in Singapore during the Singapore Urban Mobility Week. The introduction marks JBM EV's expansion into the Southeast Asian market for commercial electric vehicle transport solutions.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Smart #2 celebrates market debut in China
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Smart's electric two-seater city car has launched in China with the Premium trim level priced at 102,900 yuan, approximately €14,000. The #2 serves as the successor to the iconic Smart ForTwo and represents the brand's commitment to compact urban electric mobility.

world-news.title: US urges China to honour Busan trade deal commitments
world-news.summary: The United States is pressing China to fulfill its obligations under the Trump-Xi Busan trade agreement, which aims to reduce tariffs and ease technology restrictions between the two nations. The success of this major bilateral trade accord depends on China's adherence to agreed-upon commitments.

world-news.title: Iran war live: Qatar says US, Iran should not wait to reach a peace deal
world-news.summary: Qatar's prime minister has urged the United States and Iran to accelerate peace negotiations without waiting for ideal conditions, signaling international diplomatic efforts to resolve ongoing tensions. The call reflects regional concern about prolonged conflict between the two powers.

world-news.title: Paraguay's Santiago Pena under arrest, new president Pedro Alliana sworn in
world-news.summary: Paraguay has experienced a sudden leadership transition with the arrest of former president Santiago Pena and the swearing-in of new president Pedro Alliana, amid the nation's financial crisis following the collapse of the Ueno Bank. The political upheaval reflects broader economic instability in the South American nation.

world-news.title: EU prosecutor office investigates fatal train crash in Spain
world-news.summary: European Union prosecutors have launched an investigation into Spain's railway administration, safety agencies, and state auditors following a deadly train crash that killed 69 people. The probe examines potential misuse of EU funds allocated for railway upgrades.

world-news.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
world-news.summary: Spanish rail authorities are under investigation by European prosecutors regarding potential fraud involving EU funds designated for railway modernization on the line where a train crash killed 69 people. The investigation marks a significant international accountability measure involving EU infrastructure spending.

world-news.title: EU tells TikTok to fix 'harmful' For You feed, threatens fines
world-news.summary: The European Commission has ordered TikTok to address algorithmic issues with its recommendation system that allegedly leads users into problematic content loops, with the threat of substantial financial penalties. The regulatory action represents a major international technology governance intervention.

world-news.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
world-news.summary: Technology and artificial intelligence stocks have recovered following a significant market selloff driven partly by concerns that Democrat election victories would slow AI development. The market volatility reflects investor anxiety about policy impacts on the global tech sector.

world-news.title: New Zealanders head to polls on final day of voting
world-news.summary: New Zealand voters are casting ballots on the final day of an election marked by close competition between major parties, with early voting already exceeding 50 percent of eligible voters. The election outcome may have implications for regional geopolitics and trade relationships in the Pacific.

world-news.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
world-news.summary: A series of bomb threats targeting European airlines have disrupted aviation across the continent, though no explosives have been discovered and investigators have found no confirmed link to similar threats against media outlets. The security incidents reflect ongoing concerns about aviation safety and international terrorism.

world-news.title: CDC reports more than 5,000 measles cases, highest number in 35 years
world-news.summary: The United States Centers for Disease Control reports over 5,000 confirmed measles cases, marking the highest number in three and a half decades, with children and teenagers comprising nearly 60 percent of cases. The public health crisis reflects declining vaccination rates and has potential implications for global disease surveillance.

science-space.title: Hera probe gets 1st good look at asteroid system clobbered by NASA's DART mission
science-space.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has obtained its first close-up observations of the Didymos binary asteroid system, which was previously impacted by NASA's DART mission. This milestone represents a critical follow-up to humanity's first planetary defense test, providing scientists with crucial data on the effectiveness of kinetic impact technology.

science-space.title: Giant exoplanet emerges from the dark when the James Webb Space Telescope turns out the starlight
science-space.summary: Astronomers have successfully used advanced imaging techniques with the James Webb Space Telescope to filter out starlight and directly observe a giant exoplanet that would otherwise remain invisible. This breakthrough in exoplanet imaging demonstrates new capabilities for studying distant planetary systems and their characteristics.

science-space.title: AST SpaceMobile announces new 'Blacklift' rocket, targets 2028 launch debut
science-space.summary: AST SpaceMobile has announced plans to develop and manufacture its own launch vehicle called Blacklift, with an anticipated operational debut in 2028. The company intends to use this in-house rocket to deploy its broadband satellite constellation, marking a significant step toward vertical integration in the commercial space industry.

science-space.title: SpaceX launches mystery mission for US Space Force in gorgeous sunset liftoff from California
science-space.summary: SpaceX successfully conducted its 125th orbital launch of 2026, carrying a classified payload for the U.S. Space Force from a California launch facility. The mission highlights the company's continued operational tempo and its role as a primary launch provider for national security space operations.

science-space.title: APOD: 2026 November 5 – Enceladus in Silhouette
science-space.summary: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day features Saturn's moon Enceladus captured in silhouette, revealing the icy moon's atmospheric features and surface characteristics through backlighting from the Sun. The image provides insights into one of the solar system's most scientifically interesting ocean worlds.

science-space.title: APOD: 2026 November 6 – A Farewell to Swift
science-space.summary: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day commemorates the Swift space telescope, a pioneering X-ray observatory that revolutionized the study of gamma-ray bursts and other transient celestial phenomena. The featured image reflects on the scientific legacy of the mission as it approaches the end of its operational lifetime.

science-space.title: M30's Sparkling Stars
science-space.summary: The Hubble Space Telescope has captured a detailed image of Messier 30, a globular star cluster cataloged by 18th-century astronomer Charles Messier. The observation provides astronomers with high-resolution data on stellar populations and galactic history within this ancient collection of stars.

science-space.title: You can see another galaxy with the naked eye — here's how to find it
science-space.summary: The Andromeda galaxy remains visible to the unaided human eye, making it the most distant object humans can observe without optical aid. The article provides guidance for amateur astronomers on locating and observing this neighboring galaxy despite its apparent faintness.

science-space.title: What's that bright 'star' in the early morning sky? It's not a star at all!
science-space.summary: Venus is currently visible as an exceptionally bright object in the eastern sky before sunrise and will continue to increase in brightness as it approaches its maximum elongation later in November. The planet's appearance offers skywatchers an excellent opportunity to observe the brightest natural object in the night sky after the Moon.

science-space.title: On this day in space! Nov. 6, 1572: A German astronomer discovers the Tycho supernova with the naked eye
science-space.summary: On November 6, 1572, German astronomer Wolfgang Schulër observed a supernova that would later be named after Tycho Brahe, marking a significant moment in astronomical history. The discovery challenged prevailing beliefs about the immutability of the heavens and contributed to the scientific revolution.

finance-markets.title: US stocks stage tepid recovery after $3.2tn rout fuelled by AI fears
finance-markets.summary: American equity markets mounted a weak rebound following a $3.2 trillion selloff driven by artificial intelligence concerns, though the magnitude of gains remained modest relative to historical recoveries from severe market downturns. The limited recovery suggests lingering investor anxiety over technology valuations and AI-related risks.

finance-markets.title: Anthropic to press ahead with IPO targeting $1.5tn valuation
finance-markets.summary: AI laboratory Anthropic, maker of the Claude chatbot, intends to pursue an initial public offering with a target valuation of $1.5 trillion before Thanksgiving, undeterred by the recent technology sector rout. The move signals confidence in the AI sector despite broader market turbulence affecting tech equities.

finance-markets.title: US warns China it must 'immediately' meet terms of Busan trade deal
finance-markets.summary: The United States has issued a formal warning to China demanding immediate compliance with commitments under the Busan trade agreement, specifically regarding the supply of rare earths and other critical materials. The escalation reflects growing tension over supply chain vulnerabilities and strategic resource availability.

finance-markets.title: China Extends Gold-Buying Streak to Two Years as Prices Drop
finance-markets.summary: China's central bank continued its two-year gold accumulation streak in October, adding to reserves even as precious metal prices declined nearly 7% and fell below the $4,000-per-ounce threshold. The sustained purchasing pattern indicates China's strategic commitment to diversifying foreign reserves amid currency and geopolitical concerns.

finance-markets.title: Beijing Vows to Hit Back Against US Sanctions on China Companies
finance-markets.summary: China's Ministry of Commerce has declared strong opposition to recent U.S. sanctions on Chinese companies and signaled its intention to pursue retaliatory measures to protect national interests. The statement escalates trade and geopolitical tensions between the world's two largest economies.

finance-markets.title: Low-profile Wall Street firm to double down on Anthropic despite tech rout
finance-markets.summary: XN, a relatively low-visibility Wall Street investment firm, has accumulated a $5.3 billion stake in AI laboratory Anthropic through multiple private-round investments and plans to increase its exposure despite the broader technology sector downturn. The commitment demonstrates conviction in Anthropic's valuation and AI market potential among select institutional investors.

finance-markets.title: Braskem Owners Pull Funding Offer as Debt Talks Hit Snag
finance-markets.summary: Brazil's Braskem SA has encountered obstacles in debt restructuring negotiations with creditors, prompting shareholders to withdraw a proposed capital injection that was central to achieving an out-of-court settlement. The breakdown in talks raises concerns about the petrochemical company's financial stability and debt sustainability.

finance-markets.title: Elanco Shares Jump After Q3 Beat and Outlook Raise
finance-markets.summary: Elanco Animal Health shares surged nearly 8% following better-than-expected third-quarter earnings results and an elevated full-year guidance, driven by 11% reported growth and broad-based strength across markets and product lines. The performance demonstrates resilience in the animal health sector amid broader market volatility.

finance-markets.title: FIGS Beats Earnings as Demand Outstrips Supply, CEO Trina Spear Says
finance-markets.summary: FIGS reported third-quarter revenue of $190.7 million, exceeding consensus estimates, with its fourth consecutive quarter of at least 25% revenue growth driven by expansion beyond core scrubs into complementary health care apparel. The company demonstrated strong international expansion and product line diversification across work and leisure categories.

finance-markets.title: Sweetgreen CEO Says Sales Rebound After Cyclospora-Related Traffic Drop
finance-markets.summary: Sweetgreen reported improving sales momentum with October comparable growth of approximately 5% following a summer cyclosporiasis outbreak that had suppressed restaurant traffic industry-wide and triggered a September flat-comp performance. Early November trends indicate continued recovery as consumer confidence in dining returns.

tech-ai.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
tech-ai.summary: OpenAI has raised an additional $11 billion in a funding round expected to close in the coming weeks, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The company is reportedly pursuing further investments that could increase the total to $20 billion, cementing its position as one of the world's most valuable companies following a previous $122 billion raise at an $852 billion valuation in March.

tech-ai.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
tech-ai.summary: New data from Ramp reveals that despite continued growth in AI usage, spending on AI services has stalled amid price cuts and smarter cost controls from major spenders. The slowdown could challenge investor expectations for AI hypergrowth as rival Anthropic prepares for its initial public offering.

tech-ai.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
tech-ai.summary: China's Ministry of State Security recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and gather intelligence on American AI chips, according to the New York Times. The effort aimed to obtain information that could potentially influence Nvidia to make advanced chips available to China.

tech-ai.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
tech-ai.summary: Voters approved restrictions on data center development in 40 out of 41 ballot measures during midterm elections, signaling potential regulatory headwinds for AI infrastructure expansion. The results suggest the public may increasingly oppose the rapid scaling of energy-intensive data centers required for AI development.

tech-ai.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
tech-ai.summary: Crusoe Energy has sold its challenged Wyoming data center project to Google, highlighting ongoing difficulties in developing massive AI data centers at scale. The transaction underscores the operational and financial complexities facing companies attempting to build critical infrastructure for AI workloads.

tech-ai.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
tech-ai.summary: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting the Artex penetration testing tool exposed publicly on the internet, allowing unrestricted access to the hacking platform. The exposure demonstrates significant security vulnerabilities in AI-related development tools and infrastructure.

tech-ai.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
tech-ai.summary: Meta has launched Spaces, a new feature enabling users to build customized, app-like experiences within its Muse AI assistant for tasks such as shopping, task management, and entertainment. The feature allows Muse to integrate with external applications like Gmail and Google Calendar to provide contextual assistance.

tech-ai.title: All the latest updates on AI data centers
tech-ai.summary: The expansion of energy-intensive AI data centers has become a bipartisan political issue, with voters largely opposing development at recent elections amid concerns over power grid capacity and environmental impact. Tech giants including OpenAI and Amazon are pledging increased collaboration with communities and regulators as they scale infrastructure to support AI operations.

tech-ai.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
tech-ai.summary: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to battery technology startup 6K to scale manufacturing of its microwave-plasma battery materials in the United States. The investment reflects government interest in securing domestic supply chains for advanced battery technologies.

tech-ai.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
tech-ai.summary: Amazon has enabled users to text Alexa for shopping assistance, a feature set to roll out to millions of users in the coming weeks. The move represents Amazon's continued integration of AI capabilities into its Alexa assistant to enhance e-commerce functionality.

health-biotech.title: New tumor cases show common gene therapy tool can come with risk
health-biotech.summary: Novartis has disclosed seven previously unreported cases of tumors in children who received Zolgensma, a gene therapy for spinal muscular atrophy, raising significant safety concerns for the field. The cases highlight potential risks associated with AAV-based gene therapies, a widely used delivery mechanism in development across multiple therapeutic areas.

health-biotech.title: Seven new tumor cases reported among patients on Novartis' Zolgensma gene therapy
health-biotech.summary: Novartis confirmed that nine patients receiving Zolgensma for spinal muscular atrophy have developed tumors, with seven cases disclosed for the first time and two showing evidence of viral vector integration into patient DNA. This disclosure raises critical questions about the long-term safety profile of gene therapies using similar delivery mechanisms.

health-biotech.title: J&J's Rybrevant nets FDA approval in head and neck cancer
health-biotech.summary: Johnson & Johnson has received accelerated FDA approval for Rybrevant in recurrent head and neck cancer previously treated with chemotherapy and immunotherapy. The approval marks the first major advancement in this indication in a decade.

health-biotech.title: Amgen's Repatha linked to fewer heart attacks
health-biotech.summary: New clinical evidence demonstrates that Amgen's Repatha reduces the incidence of heart attacks in cardiovascular disease patients. The data supports the cardiovascular benefits of the PCSK9 inhibitor in clinical practice.

health-biotech.title: #SITC26: Immunocore reports early data for brenetafusp plus Kimmtrak in uveal melanoma
health-biotech.summary: Immunocore presented early clinical data showing approximately 70% of uveal melanoma patients remained alive at two years when treated with a combination of two bispecific T cell engagers. The results represent a promising approach to combining immunotherapy agents in solid tumors.

health-biotech.title: Sarepta quits enrolling for confirmatory Phase 3 trial of Elevidys
health-biotech.summary: Sarepta Therapeutics has discontinued enrollment in the Phase 3 confirmatory trial for Elevidys, its Duchenne muscular dystrophy gene therapy intended for older boys. The decision suggests potential challenges in generating additional clinical evidence for the therapy's efficacy.

health-biotech.title: Moderna notches small profit as it prioritizes work on cancer vaccines
health-biotech.summary: Moderna achieved its first profitable quarter in two years, driven by international COVID-19 vaccine sales, while shifting strategic focus toward cancer vaccine development. The financial milestone reflects the company's transition away from pandemic-focused revenue streams.

health-biotech.title: States sue Trump administration again to delay Medicaid work requirements
health-biotech.summary: Multiple states have filed another lawsuit challenging the Trump administration's implementation of Medicaid work requirements, less than a week after a federal judge ruled that the requirements would cause irreparable harm. The legal action underscores ongoing disputes over Medicaid policy changes.

health-biotech.title: Two incoming lawmakers plan to defend health equity from Trump administration cuts
health-biotech.summary: Two newly elected lawmakers with science backgrounds have announced plans to oppose proposed Trump administration cuts to health equity programs. Their advocacy signals legislative efforts to preserve funding for underserved population health initiatives.

health-biotech.title: Head of family physician group seeks ACIP 'guardrails'
health-biotech.summary: The CEO of the American Academy of Family Physicians is calling on Congress to establish protective measures for the CDC's Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices following over a year of institutional turmoil. The appeal highlights concerns about the committee's governance and independence.

cybersecurity.title: FBI Arrests Executive at Ransomware Negotiation Firm
cybersecurity.summary: The FBI arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm in connection with an investigation into the ShinyHunters hacking group, which recently stole sensitive data on thousands of FBI agents. The arrest represents a significant development in federal efforts to disrupt ransomware operations and those facilitating extortion activities.

cybersecurity.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
cybersecurity.summary: U.S. federal investigators have identified executives at ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the ShinyHunters hacking group, with one executive allegedly helping operate an extortion website. The investigation reveals potential corruption within the ransomware negotiation industry itself.

cybersecurity.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services
cybersecurity.summary: Blockchain analysis firm Chainalysis disclosed that an agentic cyber attack exposed names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users, forcing the company to remove access to critical services. The breach raises concerns about the security of infrastructure used for cryptocurrency and financial investigations.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released updates addressing over 1,400 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software, significantly exceeding its previous record of nearly 1,000 fixes in September. The massive patch volume underscores the increasing complexity of enterprise software security landscapes.

cybersecurity.title: Experts Demonstrate Barracuda Email Security Gateway Chain Enabling Root Access Without Login
cybersecurity.summary: Two chained vulnerabilities in Barracuda's Email Security Gateway allow unauthenticated attackers to gain root-level access to the appliance without login credentials. The attack chain demonstrates critical risks in email security infrastructure and was detailed by watchTowr after patches were released.

cybersecurity.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors began exploiting a recently disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-123158 within hours of its public disclosure, successfully achieving root access on honeypot systems. The flaw affects Linux systems running OpenSSH on musl C library with PAM disabled.

cybersecurity.title: Hackers Hide Linux Backdoor in Control Web Panel Server to Execute Commands Without Logs
cybersecurity.summary: A backdoor discovered in the Control Web Panel web server allows attackers to execute commands without leaving traces in access logs, according to researchers at QiAnXin's XLab. The backdoor requires root-level access to install, suggesting attackers must already control the compromised server.

cybersecurity.title: Installing the Fix for an Exploited WordPress Flaw Can Expose Some Sites One Last Time
cybersecurity.summary: A researcher at Picus Security discovered that WordPress sites can be attacked during the patching process itself, as the update installation uses legacy unpatched code before applying the fix. This window of vulnerability presents a critical timing issue for site administrators deploying security updates.

cybersecurity.title: Malicious Browser Extensions Could Use Claude Dispatch to Run Code on Users' Computers
cybersecurity.summary: Researchers at Forever Security demonstrated that malicious browser extensions exploiting Claude's Dispatch feature can execute arbitrary code on users' computers through Claude Desktop. The vulnerability remains unpatched and poses risks to users of the popular AI assistant.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available, but Windows Update Won't Deliver It
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released a fix for CVE-2026-83844, a remote code execution flaw in Windows Paint, through the Microsoft Store rather than traditional Windows Updates. The vulnerability, an out-of-bounds read vulnerability, requires users to manually update Paint through the Store to receive the security patch.

crypto-web3.title: Treasury cuts off MEXC Global over alleged $16 billion in transactions linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia
crypto-web3.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department has severed MEXC Global from the American financial system following allegations that the exchange facilitated approximately $16 billion in transactions connected to sanctioned entities including Iran, North Korea, and Russia. This enforcement action represents a significant regulatory crackdown on cryptocurrency exchanges suspected of circumventing international sanctions.

crypto-web3.title: Trump administration moves closer to allowing crypto in 401(k) retirement plans
crypto-web3.summary: A regulatory proposal that would permit alternative assets, including cryptocurrencies, to be held within 401(k) retirement accounts has advanced to White House review under the Trump administration. This potential policy shift could significantly expand institutional and retail access to crypto holdings within mainstream retirement savings vehicles.

crypto-web3.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
crypto-web3.summary: Major technology companies Apple and Meta have declined participation in a tokenized stock initiative involving OKX and ICE, with approximately 90% of issuers opting out of the program. This leaves cryptocurrency firms such as Coinbase, Circle, and Robinhood as primary participants in the tokenized securities venture.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
crypto-web3.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has mandated that regulated prediction market exchanges cannot implement state-by-state customer restrictions, directly contradicting court orders faced by firms like Kalshi. This regulatory conflict creates significant compliance uncertainty for prediction market operators navigating federal and judicial directives.

crypto-web3.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
crypto-web3.summary: Greece has enacted new taxation on cryptocurrency gains at 10% and decentralized finance income at 15%, while offering a 12-month amnesty period for investors to declare past holdings without late-filing penalties. The legislation leaves unresolved questions regarding the treatment of crypto-to-crypto transactions for tax purposes.

crypto-web3.title: US Treasury walks back crypto surveillance 'travel rule' proposal
crypto-web3.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department has withdrawn a controversial proposal that would have expanded surveillance requirements for cryptocurrency transactions under the travel rule framework. The withdrawal represents a reversal of a policy that had faced significant industry opposition over compliance costs and privacy concerns.

crypto-web3.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
crypto-web3.summary: Major crypto platforms Coinbase, Robinhood, and Circle are diversifying into stablecoins, payments infrastructure, and prediction markets, yet recent earnings reports reveal continued difficulty in establishing profitable revenue streams amid market volatility. The industry's expansion into new verticals highlights persistent challenges in escaping crypto's cyclical boom-and-bust patterns.

crypto-web3.title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swapped stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
crypto-web3.summary: Blockchain analytics firm Elliptic reports that perpetrators of a significant Binance hack converted stolen tokens into approximately $124 million in bitcoin, with the majority of stolen assets remaining locked rather than liquidated. Binance has announced plans to progressively reopen additional withdrawal channels as it manages the aftermath of the security breach.

crypto-web3.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
crypto-web3.summary: Thailand's Securities and Exchange Commission has filed criminal charges against Bitget's operator, alleging operation of an unlicensed cryptocurrency exchange serving Thai users between 2022 and 2025. The enforcement action jeopardizes the exchange's planned local acquisition and regulatory standing in the Southeast Asian jurisdiction.

crypto-web3.title: Aave Labs buys Avon team in fixed-rate lending push
crypto-web3.summary: Aave Labs has acquired the team and technology assets of Avon, a protocol offering onchain fixed-rate and floating-rate lending capabilities, as part of its strategy to expand lending product offerings. The acquisition strengthens Aave's position in the decentralized finance lending market by integrating specialized fixed-rate technology.

startups-vc.title: China's Largest Startup Deal Ever Lifts Global Venture Funding To $59B In October
startups-vc.summary: Global venture funding reached $59 billion in October, representing a 45% year-over-year increase, largely driven by DeepSeek's record-setting $15.9 billion funding round in China. This represents a significant milestone in the global startup ecosystem and signals sustained investor confidence in AI and technology ventures.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: AI, Defense And Space Tech Lead For Large Rounds
startups-vc.summary: Shield AI, a defense technology company focused on autonomy and virtual simulations, secured the largest weekly financing at $2 billion, followed by drone delivery provider Zipline International with $1.5 billion. This week's funding activity demonstrates strong investor appetite for AI applications in defense, aerospace, and logistics sectors.

startups-vc.title: 5 Interesting Learnings from Anthropic at $17 Billion in Quarterly Revenue
startups-vc.summary: Anthropic reported quarterly revenue of $16.96 billion, up 47% from the previous quarter and 1,127% year-over-year, with a 900% net revenue retention rate and $895 billion in compute commitments. The company's explosive growth metrics underscore the massive market opportunity for AI frontier models and infrastructure services.

startups-vc.title: 20VC x SaaStr: OpenAI Cuts to $1.25 Trillion, Anthropic's Growth Goes From 12x to 2x, and Why Agents Are an Existential Risk to DoorDash
startups-vc.summary: Recent market volatility has resulted in significant shifts in AI company valuations, with OpenAI facing substantial valuation cuts and Anthropic's growth rate moderating, while AI agents continue to disrupt traditional business models across consumer platforms. The week highlighted major M&A activity, including DoorDash's $17 billion acquisition of Instacart and discussions around emerging AI infrastructure startups.

startups-vc.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
startups-vc.summary: The midterm election results may significantly impact the AI and data center industries, with voters approving stricter regulations on data center development in 40 of 41 ballot measures across the country. These regulatory trends could reshape infrastructure investment and operational costs for AI companies and cloud service providers.

startups-vc.title: Top 5 Learnings from Vercel's COO: 10 SDRs Down to 1, a $5K-a-Year Lead Agent, and 93% of Support Cases Handled by AI
startups-vc.summary: Vercel's COO shared insights on the company's aggressive AI automation strategy, reducing sales development representative headcount from 10 to 1 through an AI agent that costs approximately $5,000 annually, while AI now handles 93% of support cases. These operational efficiencies demonstrate the practical business impact of deploying AI agents for revenue and support functions in SaaS organizations.

startups-vc.title: How To Challenge A Monopoly In The AI Age
startups-vc.summary: AI chip startups can compete against dominant incumbents by developing superior hardware tailored to specific emerging use cases like inference, similar to how Juniper challenged Cisco with new network architecture. Success requires proving tangible advantages, reducing customer switching costs, and employing agile teams that anticipate unmet market needs before larger competitors.

startups-vc.title: The Crunchbase Tech Layoffs Tracker
startups-vc.summary: Over 127,000 workers at U.S.-based tech companies were laid off in mass job cuts during 2025, with layoffs continuing into 2026 according to Crunchbase News tracking data. The ongoing workforce reductions reflect broader challenges in the tech sector's economic conditions and operational efficiency strategies.

startups-vc.title: To Really Scale, You Need $1M on Your Balance Sheet for Every $2M in ARR
startups-vc.summary: According to SaaS industry guidance, scaling startups should maintain a minimum cash-to-ARR ratio of 1:2, meaning a company with $20 million in annual recurring revenue should hold at least $10 million in cash reserves. This financial principle emphasizes the importance of maintaining adequate capital reserves to support hiring, token consumption, and operational investments necessary for reaching the next growth stage.

startups-vc.title: General Catalyst Tops Lead Investors For October In Busy Month For US Startup Dealmaking
startups-vc.summary: October 2026 saw robust U.S. startup funding activity, with General Catalyst emerging as the leading venture investor across key metrics including lead deal count and largest lead investments. The report provides comprehensive rankings of active venture investors during a particularly active month for American startup dealmaking.

energy-climate.title: State of the climate: 2026 likely to tie with 2024 as the warmest year on record
energy-climate.summary: With three-quarters of 2026 complete, data indicates the year will rank as either the warmest or second-warmest on record, continuing a trend of escalating global temperatures. This milestone underscores the accelerating pace of climate change and its immediate impacts on weather systems worldwide.

energy-climate.title: 'Simply staggering': Rapidly developing 'super El Niño' on track to peak in December
energy-climate.summary: A developing 'super El Niño' climate phenomenon is expected to reach its peak by late 2026, with scientists warning it will drive average global temperatures to unprecedented levels. The event represents a significant climate disruption that will amplify existing warming trends and intensify extreme weather patterns globally.

energy-climate.title: UK climate minister Katie White: COP31 must respond to 'really scary' science
energy-climate.summary: UK climate minister Katie White has emphasized that the upcoming COP31 climate negotiations in Antalya, Turkey must directly address alarming new scientific findings on global warming. The statement signals that policymakers recognize the urgency of translating climate science into concrete international commitments.

energy-climate.title: World's largest liquid-air storage facility comes online in China
energy-climate.summary: China's 60 MW/600 MWh liquid-air energy storage facility in Qinghai began commercial operation on October 30, representing a major breakthrough in long-duration energy storage technology. The facility's 10-hour continuous power output capacity demonstrates the viability of domestically developed LAES technology for large-scale renewable energy integration.

energy-climate.title: Longi achieves 35.31% efficiency in perovskite-silicon tandem solar cell based on self-assembled molecules
energy-climate.summary: Longi has achieved a certified efficiency of 35.25% in a perovskite-silicon tandem solar cell using engineered molecules to enhance interface quality and charge extraction. The device demonstrated strong operational stability, retaining 94% of its initial efficiency after 1,500 hours of continuous operation, advancing the commercial viability of next-generation solar technology.

energy-climate.title: Sodium-ion batteries approach cost parity with LFP, with 70 GWh covered by supply agreements
energy-climate.summary: Sodium-ion battery technology is approaching cost parity with lithium iron phosphate cells, with global supply agreements now covering over 70 GWh of capacity. Analysis indicates sodium-ion batteries could deliver 21% lower total cost of ownership over a 20-year period despite higher initial expenses, offering a competitive alternative for energy storage applications.

energy-climate.title: Türkiye targets 175 GW of solar, wind capacity by 2040
energy-climate.summary: Türkiye has announced an energy vision for 2040 that targets 175 GW of combined solar and wind capacity, aiming to increase renewables' share of total installed capacity to 77% from approximately 63% today. The ambitious target reflects the country's commitment to significant energy transition and decarbonization.

energy-climate.title: Group14 Technologies secures $167m for global and European expansion
energy-climate.summary: Group14 Technologies has closed a €150 million Series D equity extension to fund international manufacturing expansion and strengthen its presence in the battery materials sector. The investment supports the company's capacity to supply critical materials for the growing energy storage and electric vehicle markets.

energy-climate.title: The Hydrogen Stream: H2 turbines can push LCOHS to around $0.62/kg
energy-climate.summary: Australian researchers have found that hydrogen gas turbines could provide more cost-effective backup power than fuel cells during periods of low solar availability, with hydrogen production costs potentially reaching $0.62 per kilogram. The study demonstrates how underground hydrogen storage properties and system design optimization can improve economics of renewable energy backup systems.

energy-climate.title: Energix commissions 152MWdc Border Basin Solar project in Ohio
energy-climate.summary: Energix US has commissioned the Border Basin Solar project, a utility-scale 152 MWdc facility in Ohio that will supply electricity to the PJM Interconnection market. The project represents a significant addition to renewable energy capacity in the region and advances solar deployment in the eastern United States.

asia-pacific.title: How North Korea turns child prodigies into crypto thieves
asia-pacific.summary: North Korea operates a sophisticated decade-old hacking program that recruits approximately 200 of the nation's top middle school students annually to study computer engineering, incentivizing them with apartments and hard currency rewards. The program has produced elite hackers responsible for major international cyber thefts, including a $6.3 billion Binance cryptocurrency heist, representing a significant regional cybersecurity threat.

asia-pacific.title: How China's Naval-Air Reach Is Offsetting the Malacca Dilemma
asia-pacific.summary: China's expanding military and political reach across the Asia-Pacific region is reducing its vulnerability to maritime disruption through the Malacca Strait, a critical chokepoint for regional trade and energy security. The strategic expansion demonstrates Beijing's efforts to mitigate geopolitical risks while increasing costs for potential adversaries seeking to exploit this dependency.

asia-pacific.title: Myanmar's will to fight money laundering questioned as tougher curbs loom
asia-pacific.summary: Myanmar faces potential enhanced international financial sanctions from the Financial Action Task Force if it fails to strengthen its anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing safeguards by a specified deadline. Analysts suggest the military-backed government's reluctance to address these concerns may become a greater obstacle to economic recovery than international restrictions themselves.

asia-pacific.title: Is Russia's seizure of Japan Tobacco assets the last straw for Tokyo amid frosty ties?
asia-pacific.summary: Russia seized Japan Tobacco International's assets through a Kremlin decree, prompting Japan to lodge a formal complaint and demand immediate reversal amid escalating bilateral tensions. Analysts view the seizure as potential retribution and a possible critical breaking point in already-strained Japan-Russia relations.

asia-pacific.title: Green Hydrogen: India's Big Ambitions, Costly Realities
asia-pacific.summary: India's strategic ambitions to establish itself as a global green hydrogen export hub are confronted by high production costs, inadequate infrastructure, and uncertain domestic demand dynamics. The gap between government targets and economic viability presents a significant challenge to India's clean energy transition strategy.

asia-pacific.title: By all memes: why Asia's Gen Z are revolting
asia-pacific.summary: Anti-establishment protests led by Asia's Generation Z are spreading across the region, with digitally-native youth leveraging memes and social media to mobilize against specific government policies and injustices. With Asia home to approximately 1 billion adolescents and young people, this trend represents a significant emerging force in regional political dynamics.

asia-pacific.title: Beijing Has Little Reason to Welcome America's Midterm Results
asia-pacific.summary: China has developed a pragmatic working relationship with Trump's transactional approach to diplomacy, making potential Democratic congressional gains disadvantageous for Beijing. A Democratic-led Congress could reshape U.S.-China relations and reinforce democratic values as a counterweight to Chinese interests in the region.

asia-pacific.title: Why a Democrat-Held Congress in Washington Could Be Bad News for Modi's India
asia-pacific.summary: Unlike the Trump administration, a Democratic-controlled U.S. Congress has demonstrated vocal criticism of India's democratic backsliding and human rights concerns under Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This potential shift in American political dynamics could introduce scrutiny and pressure on India's governance practices previously absent during the Trump era.

asia-pacific.title: Hong Kong draws growing interest from Irish firms seeking expansion across Asia
asia-pacific.summary: Irish businesses are increasingly viewing Hong Kong as a strategic base for broader Asian expansion amid U.S. trade policy uncertainties and Brexit consequences affecting European markets. The growing momentum reflects Hong Kong's continued role as a regional commercial hub despite geopolitical complexities.

asia-pacific.title: India's Rediscovery of Poland: The Drivers and Limits of a Growing Partnership
asia-pacific.summary: India and Poland are strengthening bilateral relations driven by geopolitical alignment and economic interests, though policy divergences exist regarding Russia and other strategic issues. The developing partnership reflects India's broader engagement diversification with European nations amid evolving regional dynamics.
